newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details elevator space, railcar unload at port.
newsitem.headline: CWB details elevator space, railcar unload at port.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Tuesday detailed the amount of space available in primary elevators across the Prairies and the number of rail hopper cars unloaded at export positions.
Primary elevator space tightened as the harvest progressed with 37 percent of space available, the CWB said.
Alberta elevators had the most space available at 46 percent, Saskatchewan followed at 35 percent and Manitoba had 31 percent of space empty.
Rail hopper car unloads at the West Coast totalled 2,247, below the 2,400 target.
Unloads at Thunder Bay were 1,527, below the 1,990 target.
Unloads at Churchill were 247, below the 300 target.
